events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the day hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Three decades since we lost a true legend. Tupac's music and influence continue to resonate. What's your go-to Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Remembered
events.blurb: Marking 56 years since the passing of guitar virtuoso Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: A true innovator. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible on a guitar. His music still sounds as fresh and electrifying today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: That album cover. Those tracks. 'Abbey Road' is 57 today! What's your favourite moment from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the 75th birthday of The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the inimitable Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude have fronted The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye.

angles.name: Liam G's Best Moment
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Liam Gallagher, a true rock'n'roll icon. What's his most legendary moment for you?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod: 25 Years On
events.blurb: Apple released the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, it changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and what's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and musical genius of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Diversity
angles.copy: An eclectic masterpiece! The 'White Album' is 58 today, showcasing The Beatles at their most diverse. Which track is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Unmatched Talent
angles.copy: 35 years since we said goodbye to a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! This album marked a pivotal shift for The Beatles and pop music. What's your standout track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Remembered
events.blurb: Marking 46 years since the tragic passing of music legend John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: 46 years on, John Lennon's message of peace and his incredible musical legacy continue to inspire millions. His voice lives on.
